text: 本人男，21岁，说一下自己吧
en: Male, 21 years old, let me say a bit about myself.

text: 前段时间遇见了一个姑娘，比我大一岁，接触不久就发现自己喜欢上了她，这个姑娘聪明，漂亮，充满魅力，真的很吸引人。
en: A while ago I met a girl, a year older than me. Not long after we started talking I realised I'd fallen for her. She's clever, pretty, full of charm - really captivating.

text: 发现自己喜欢上她之后，就开始展开攻势，我属于比较温柔的人，爱情观属于细水长流的那种，生活中的细节我都会注意到，但是比较含蓄，可能表面上的关心和爱惜表露的不是太明显，毕竟大家也都是成年人，我感觉每个人都有自己私人的空间，喜欢归喜欢，但也不想过度的打扰她，而且说实话，在自己喜欢的人面前，有些时候真的像个孩子哈哈哈哈哈控制不住自己，因为真的喜欢她
en: After realising I'd fallen for her, I started making my move. I'm a fairly gentle sort, and my view of love is the slow-burning kind. I notice the little details in daily life, but I'm rather reserved - the care and affection I show on the surface might not be all that obvious. After all, we're all adults, and I feel everyone deserves their own private space. I like her, yes, but I didn't want to bother her too much. And to be honest, in front of the person I like, sometimes I really am like a child, hahahaha, I just can't control myself, because I genuinely like her.

text: 她对我的态度属于不反感，也会主动找我聊天，见面也挺开心，当我觉得这次好像终于可以脱离单身苦海的时候，她发了一条这样的微博：【刚想截图的时候发现她给删了，大概意思就是：见到自己喜欢的人就会很开心，然后@了另一个男用户】
en: Her attitude towards me was one of not being put off - she'd even take the initiative to chat with me, and we were happy enough whenever we met. Just when I thought I might finally escape the sea of single suffering, she posted a Weibo like this: [I'd just gone to take a screenshot when I found she'd deleted it; the gist was: she gets really happy whenever she sees the person she likes, and then she @ed another male user]

text: 我看到之后就炸了
en: When I saw it I just exploded.

text: 这个人是谁啊，为什么会被@啊，她俩什么关系啊
en: Who is this person? Why was he @ed? What's the relationship between them?

text: 熬了一晚上第二天上午十点（十点大概都起床了吧）真的忍不住了问了她：你是不是脱单了啊？
en: I stayed up all night, and at ten the next morning (by ten everyone's probably up, right) I really couldn't hold back and asked her: have you got yourself a partner?

text: 她说算是吧
en: She said, more or less, yes.

text: 我说什么叫算是？
en: I said, what do you mean 'more or less'?

text: 她说身边有一个男的喜欢她，对她也不错而且喜欢粘着他（她喜欢被人粘）可是有点太粘了，而且她不确定自己是不是喜欢那个男的，微博是那个男的逼她发的，不发就闹就撒娇
en: She said there's a guy around her who likes her, treats her well, and likes to cling to her (she enjoys being clung to), but he's a bit too clingy, and she's not sure whether she actually likes that guy. That Weibo post was something he forced her to put up - if she didn't, he'd make a scene and act all coy.

text: 我心想着那还不是时间长就从了呗
en: I thought to myself, well, given enough time she'd just give in, wouldn't she.

text: 心里很难受，真的，她跟那个男的认识时间还没我长
en: It really hurt, honestly. She'd known that guy for less time than she's known me.

text: 谁不想粘着她呢？
en: Who wouldn't want to cling to her?

text: 可能我有些自卑，觉得粘着她她会烦我
en: Maybe I'm a bit insecure, thinking that if I clung to her she'd find me annoying.

text: 谁不喜欢她呢？
en: Who wouldn't like her?

text: 我见到你也一样会很开心啊
en: I'd be just as happy to see you, too.

text: 虽然我没对你说过情话，可我对你的温柔你都感觉不到吗？
en: I may never have said sweet nothings to you, but can't you feel the tenderness I have for you?

text: 她说我比她小一岁，她觉得我像个孩子
en: She said I'm a year younger than her, and she thinks I'm like a child.

text: 我在用我的方式理解你尊重你，你不觉得逼着你发微博整天粘着你粘到你都有些烦的人更像孩子吗？
en: I'm trying to understand and respect you in my own way. Don't you think the person who forces you to post on Weibo and clings to you all day until you're a bit fed up is more like a child?

text: 没有怨她的意思，只是自己自作多情，可能是我太含蓄了吧，亦或者长得难看都有可能吧（后来问了一下我第一次追的妹子，她也是用同样的理由拒绝了我，我问她当时是不是因为我长得丑才拒绝我，她说不是当时感觉你有点不成熟而已，而且你也不丑）
en: I don't mean to blame her - it's just that I'd been reading too much into it. Maybe I was too reserved, or maybe it's because I'm ugly, who knows (later I asked the girl I first chased, and she rejected me for the same reason. I asked her if she'd turned me down because I was ugly, and she said no - she'd just felt you were a bit immature at the time, and you're not ugly either)

text: 她说她拿我当好朋友
en: She said she sees me as a good friend.

text: 我说抱歉，这段时间可能多有打扰
en: I said sorry - I may have been a bit of a bother lately.

text: 我什么都没跟她说，觉得反正她也不喜欢我，说什么都像解释，可能这会她也没空理我，忙着应付粘着她的小公举吧
en: I didn't say anything to her. I figured she doesn't like me anyway, so anything I said would sound like making excuses. Maybe she's too busy to bother with me right now, busy dealing with the little princess clinging to her.

text: 男人爱上一个女人真的是出于原始欲望吗？
en: When a man falls for a woman, is it really out of primal desire?

text: 我觉得不是，大家都很成熟，提到爱，我觉得可能和肉体无关，当然也不排除在一起之后耍混的，以前不是看过男的跟女的分手之后跟女的说就当我白嫖了两年
en: I don't think so. We're all grown-ups. When it comes to love, I think it may have nothing to do with the physical - though of course there are those who mess about after getting together. Haven't we all heard of the guy who, after splitting with his girlfriend, told her to just count it as two years of me taking it all for free?

text: 最后引用一下书白发的一句话：
en: Finally, let me quote a line from Baifa Shu:

text: 然后发张自拍吧，其实我觉得自己挺难看的
en: Then I'll post a selfie. Actually, I think I'm pretty ugly.

text: 揪心啊揪心
en: Heart-wrenching, so heart-wrenching.

text: 希望自己快点走出来吧
en: Hope I can get over it soon.

text: 谢谢各位的鼓励！
en: Thank you all for the encouragement!

text: 这个回答在问世之后收到了很多知友的意见和建议，也有不少老哥老姐加微信帮我释怀，真的很感谢你们。
en: After this answer went up, it received a lot of comments and suggestions from fellow Zhihu users, and quite a few brothers and sisters added me on WeChat to help me find closure. I'm truly grateful to you all.

text: 很喜欢她，现在也是，可我真的累了，想休息
en: I like her a lot, even now, but I'm truly tired and just want to rest.

text: 仔细想想，她平时喜欢到处玩，唱k酒吧卡丁车，我呢，看书画画打游戏哈哈哈差异挺大的，导致其实我们共同语言很少，这或许就是不合适吧。
en: Thinking about it carefully, she likes going out and having fun - singing at KTV, bars, go-karting - while me, I read, draw, and play games, hahaha, so we're quite different, which meant we really had little in common. Maybe that's just incompatibility.

text: 结束了，其实感觉心里空落落的，但空洞之中也有些许感悟
en: It's over. Honestly I feel a hollow emptiness inside, but within that emptiness there are also some small realisations.

text: 感谢她的优秀，让我意识到自己的不足，虽然没能有段故事，但也让我深思自省
en: I'm grateful for her excellence, which made me aware of my own shortcomings. Although we never had a story together, it still made me reflect and examine myself.

text: 希望在下一段感情来临时，我能不这么无措吧
en: I hope that when the next relationship comes along, I won't be so at a loss.

text: 虽然经历了这么多无疾而终，但我还是觊觎爱情，因为那真是太美好了
en: Although so many of these have fizzled out without conclusion, I still covet love, because it really is too beautiful.

text: 祝各位都能幸福
en: I wish you all happiness.

text: 最后还用自拍结束吧，好多知友劝我换发型和眼镜，配了副隐形结果带不上去哈哈哈，结果还是换了框架，也学了些护肤和化妆的技巧，还用的很生涩慢慢来吧哈哈
en: Finally I'll end with another selfie. Many Zhihu friends advised me to change my hairstyle and glasses. I got a pair of contact lenses but couldn't get them in, hahaha, so I ended up going back to frames. I've also picked up some skincare and makeup tips, though I'm still pretty clumsy at them - I'll take it slow, hahaha.

text: 谢谢各位，也谢谢她
en: Thank you all, and thank her too.

text: 好久没打开知乎了，距离上次回答真有一年了，上午偶尔打开看了一眼，怎么这么多赞和回复，然后又看了一下自己两年前写的这篇文，哈哈哈哈哈哈还真觉得有点羞耻。
en: It's been ages since I opened Zhihu. It's really been a year since my last answer. I happened to open it this morning and took a look - why so many likes and replies? Then I read that piece I wrote two years ago and, hahahahaha, honestly felt a bit ashamed.

text: 这段时间终于是有了一个初恋，不过谈了八个月，也分手了，异地恋，因为工作原因可能一个月才见一次面，陪伴的太少，时间一长感情淡了，
en: During this time I finally had a first love, but we only lasted eight months before breaking up. It was a long-distance relationship; because of work we could only meet maybe once a month. There was too little company, and over time the feelings faded.

text: 对这方面我是第一次也没什么经验，很多事情处理的很失败，当爱情真正到来的时候，我才发现自己根本没有准备好，但对于爱情的渴望又让我不计后果，
en: On this front I was a first-timer with no experience, and I handled many things badly. When love truly arrived, I realised I wasn't prepared at all, yet my yearning for love made me throw caution to the wind.

text: 事后发现这跟我想完全不一样，两人之间遇到的诸多问题经常出现分歧，真的让我很受伤，但我很爱她，竭尽全力的对她好，见不得她受委屈，
en: Afterwards I found it was nothing like I'd imagined. The many problems we encountered as a couple often led to disagreement, which really hurt me. But I loved her deeply, did my utmost to be good to her, and couldn't bear to see her wronged.

text: 我的想法很简单，因为她相信我，所以我一定不辜负她，可是事与愿违，最后新鲜感过去，她选择不解决问题，逃避，冷暴力，我觉得可能是冷淡期到了，
en: My thinking was simple: because she trusted me, I absolutely would not let her down. But things went against my wishes. In the end, once the novelty wore off, she chose not to solve our problems - she avoided them, gave me the silent treatment. I thought maybe the cooling-off period had arrived.

text: 可能过去了就好，那段时间什么事都顺着她，由着她开心，但后来还是没能留住她，分开了，刚开始的我完全不能接受这样的结果，在困惑和不甘中度过了很多日子，
en: I thought it would pass and be fine. During that time I went along with everything she wanted, let her be happy, but in the end I still couldn't keep her - we split up. At first I simply couldn't accept this outcome, and I spent many days in confusion and reluctance to let go.

text: 后来时间长了，多多少少释怀看淡，现在也走出来了，果然很多事情要亲身经历才明白其中滋味，爱情就是让人舍不得丢掉的痛苦，甜的时候齁嗓子，
en: Later, as time passed, I more or less found closure and grew indifferent. I've moved on now. Sure enough, many things can only be understood by experiencing them firsthand - love is the kind of pain you can't bear to throw away; when it's sweet it's cloying.

text: 痛的时候又像刀子扎心。
en: And when it hurts, it's like a knife stabbing the heart.

text: 两张近照
en: Two recent photos.

text: （留了个小辫子，然后老被当成女孩，毕竟长得白，然后就给剪了 ）
en: (I'd grown a little plait, but people kept taking me for a girl - what with my fair skin and all - so I cut it off.)

text: 回到问题，男人的真实一面是什么样的呢，一年前我回答过，但我觉得回答的不好，太主观
en: Back to the question: what is a man's true side like? I answered this a year ago, but I don't think I answered it well - too subjective.

text: 每个男人不一样，所以真实的一面都不一样
en: Every man is different, so each one's true side is different.

text: 所以我只知道自己是什么样，代表不了所有人
en: So I only know what I'm like, and can't stand for everyone.

text: 但随着时间变化，真实的我也会变化
en: But as time changes, the real me changes too.

text: 哈哈哈真是不标准的标准答案
en: Hahaha, what a truly non-standard standard answer.

text: 行啦，到此为止
en: Alright, that's enough.

text: （然后我现在单身 ）
en: (And right now I'm single.)
